title:
On-line Extravaganza
May2021
bodyHtml:
On the 20th of May, we had our third outreach event. Despite being compelled to use an online format, we had enthusiatic participants from all around the world!

Hand in hand with Dr Nadia Maaroufi and Serafina Calarco, we learned about the relevance of fungi in soils, and about the role of the endocannabinoid system in our body.

We are looking forward to seeing you next time in person!
